brief:
Trump's incoming "Board of Peace" threatens to seize Palestinian land using strategies employed during the U.S. occupation of Iraq, according to reporting, as Palestinians face violence spanning lethal military action and administrative measures. The occupation of Gaza over three years has involved ongoing killing, alongside quieter forms of administrative violence implemented through designations and bureaucratic means that often outlast military campaigns.

The administrative dimension of dispossession operates through legal instruments and ledger entries rather than direct force, creating lasting territorial and legal changes that extend beyond periods of active combat.
dek: Palestinians learn early that violence committed against them by Israel and its allies comes in many forms. Much of it is deadly, as the past three years of ongoing genocide in Gaza have shown. Another type of violence is administrative, arriving quietly, as a designation or line in a ledger, while outlasting the bombs that make the headlines.
title: Trump's Board of Peace plans Palestinian land seizure via Iraq model
